title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Exclusions: Past-Due Installments Counted by Days Due
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Plus 150 excluded total: the past-due count.** How many installments the past-due part counts depends on two figures read from the Retail Installment Contracts contract:

- how many installments the Plus excluded total treats as past due;
- how long the oldest of them had been due on the date of loss. That length is the calendar days from the contract's next due date to the date of loss.

**Rule.**

- One installment, due no more than 20 days: none is counted.
- Two installments, with the oldest due no more than 60 days: one is counted.
- Otherwise, all are counted.

| Installments treated as past due | Days the oldest had been due | Installments counted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 | none |
| 1 | 21 | all, which is 1 |
| 2 | 60 | one |
| 2 | 61 | all, which is 2 |
| 3 or more | any | all |
